questions.question: What is the objective — click, install, purchase or awareness — and what KPI decides success?
Who is the audience, and where will they see it (placements and exact sizes in px)?
What is the headline, body copy and CTA — and are they approved? Who approves them?
What is the offer, price and deadline — exact and verifiable?
What brand, legal or compliance constraints apply (claims, disclaimers, no before/after)?
Whose ads must this beat, and what do theirs do?
How many variants are needed — how many sizes and how many hooks?
What is the brand story, and what is its voice in 3 words (formal, playful, luxury…)?
What is the full deliverables list — stationery, deck, packaging, guidelines?
Is there an existing palette (hex values) or is colour a free choice?
What type licences are already owned, and what imagery style (photo / illustration / 3D / none)?
What accessibility needs apply, and what are the print vs digital specs (bleed, CMYK, sizes)?
What is the brand name — exact spelling and case? Is there a tagline?
What does the company do, in one sentence?
What are the brand's values and personality in 3 words?
Where must the logo work — favicon 16px, 1-colour, embroidery, signage?
What colour constraints or must-avoid colours exist?
Are there existing marks to keep or kill, and which competitors' marks must this differ from?
Is there a preferred mark type (wordmark / monogram / icon / combination), or none?
Has a trademark check been done? (Never invent a check — say so if it has not.)
Which platforms, and which exact aspect ratios (1:1, 4:5, 9:16, 16:9)? Feed, story or reel cover?
What is the one message, in 10 words or fewer?
Who writes the caption and hashtags, and what is the CTA (link in bio? comment? share?)?
Is there a brand template to follow — or to break?
When is it posting, and is it tied to a campaign or date?
What safe-area and text-over-image legibility needs apply?
Which platform (iOS / Android / web / desktop) and which devices?
What is the user task and the flow — map the steps from onboarding to the core action, including success, empty and error states?
Is there an existing design system or component library (shadcn? Material? custom?)?
What real content examples and edge cases exist (long names, empty lists, errors, offline)?
What is the accessibility bar (WCAG AA?) and what motion is expected?
Which 3 shipped apps does the user admire, and why?
What is the one job of the page, and the one action the visitor should take?
Who is the audience, and what is their main objection to overcome?
Which sections are needed (hero, proof, pricing, FAQ…)?
What real proof exists — numbers, testimonials with names, logos with permission?
What are the pricing and offer details?
Is there an existing site, brand or DESIGN.md to keep? What is the tech stack and hosting?
What SEO, meta and OG needs exist, and where does the form actually send data (a real destination — never a fake 'thanks' form)?

universal.question: What is it for — the one action the viewer should take?
Who is it for — audience, age, context?
Where will it be seen — sizes, surfaces, light or dark?
What exists already — brand, logo, colours, fonts, photos, copy? Attach files or links.
What must it NOT look like, and who are the competitors to differ from?
What is the deadline and the deliverable format (file types, sizes)?
What is unknown — and who can answer it?
